description: This file defines a function for running inference using a trained linear regression model on features provided via CSV, and saves the predictions as a CSV file. It interacts with datasets loading, model loading, and storage paths modules, and logs the process.

classes.name: LinearRegressionModel
classes.description: A class representing a linear regression model with methods to load a model and perform predictions.

methods.name: tuple[str,int] predict_supervised(features_path: str, model_dir: str, horizon: int = 1)
methods.description: Runs inference on features CSV using the latest trained model, saves predictions to CSV, and returns the path to the saved predictions and the number of predictions.
